title: Concept: Registry API version disclosed (Docker-Distribution-Api-Version header)
description: The Docker-Distribution-Api-Version header marks the response as coming from a container registry and states which API version it serves. A public registry endpoint invites anonymous enumeration of repositories and tags, which often reveals internal naming and unpublished images.
applicability: Responses served by a Docker registry.
risk: A container registry is publicly identifiable and its API version is disclosed; LOW severity because access still depends on registry policy.
